mentions.name: CatchIntent
mentions.description: This app finds relevant social conversations where people are asking for what you're selling and helps turn them into qualified warm leads. It grew out of a POC the builder used to generate good leads for their first app before being converted into its own product.
mentions.problem: The builder struggled to find relevant conversations about their first app where people were exactly asking for what they were selling, and kept missing those conversations and people.
mentions.audience: Founders and business owners selling products who want to find warm leads from social conversations.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building CatchIntent (https://CatchIntent.com).
The goal is to help turning social conversations into qualified warm leads.
